# tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_setup_script (Data Source)

The shell script that installs a Sentry tunnel's WireGuard endpoint on the origin — e.g. for cloud-init `user_data`. It embeds the endpoint's private key, so it is marked sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_setup_script" "game" {
  tunnel_id = tcpshield_sentry_tunnel.game.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tunnel_id` (Number) Sentry tunnel id.

### Read-Only

- `script` (String, Sensitive) The setup script.
